company.name: Voice Agent AI
company.summary: Voice Agent AI is a next-generation AI-powered onboarding platform that helps businesses create seamless, conversational onboarding experiences using natural language processing and voice technology.
company.specialization: The platform speaks Tanglish (Tamil + English) natively for South Indian users.

documents.question: What is Voice Agent AI?
documents.answer: Voice Agent AI is a next-generation AI-powered onboarding platform that helps businesses create seamless, conversational onboarding experiences using natural language processing and voice technology. It also speaks Tanglish (Tamil + English) natively for South Indian users.
